fields.value: Approximately 52 bpm (conditional mean-interval estimate). Selected comparable positive tips are approximately evenly spaced with small visible variation. Repeated upright/deep-negative sharp complexes at similar long gaps; small pointed precomplex bumps and larger pointed recovery. Sinus bradycardia is a conditional teaching comparison; first-degree block is not established. Regular spacing near 52 and separated precomplex positive candidates support testing a sinus sequence. Candidate PR 0.19-0.29 s crosses 0.20, so it establishes neither a prolonged PR nor constant conduction. Uniform true P before every QRS and full ventricular boundaries remain unproved. The selected QRS uncertainty envelope crosses 0.12 s and establishes no narrow/wide or normal/abnormal class. The conditional candidate PR envelope is not a confirmed PR measurement, physiological variation or evidence of first-degree block. The sinus comparison additionally requires sinus-compatible P morphology in a known lead and a verified atrial-to-ventricular sequence. The course sinus-bradycardia template also specifies a constant 0.12-0.20 s PR and QRS below 0.12 s; neither interval requirement is established by these candidate envelopes. This is a comparison to test, not a preferred diagnosis.
